name: Liu Haojun
source:
"Come now, you make me sound like a villain."

A master swordsman and former Neijia practitioner; Liu Haojun, known as the Demon-Eyed Adonis, was once [url=/c7177]Kong Taoluo[/url]'s elder disciple and heir to the Neijia school of kung fu. Quickly rising through the ranks of the Qingyun Society, Haojun was forced to get cybernetic augmentations - effectively making him unable to channel internal energy, which Neijia is centered around. 

Taoluo's childhood friend and [url=/c7182]Ruili[/url]'s husband; what caused him to cut down Taoluo and organize the gang rape, murder and experimental soul transfer of Ruili is unfathomable.
